lines.say: Why do your beginner gains slow down?
In your first few weeks, you get stronger fast. But most of that isn't new muscle yet.
It's your nervous system. Your brain learns the lift, and fires more muscle fibers, at the same time.
Real muscle growth starts too. Studies can measure it after about three weeks.
But the further you are from your limit, the faster you grow. So year one is the fastest you'll ever gain.
After that, progress is slower but still real: add a little weight or a rep, and be patient.
